oracle.method: closed-form algebra and enumerated finite laws
oracle.independence_basis: Front-door adjustment evaluated in exact rationals on the retained contingency table (0.282), and E[X4|do(X2=x)] for the latent Verma SCM by enumeration over the latent variable (0.3275, 0.5025, contrast 0.175), with the 16000-row population cells verified to be integers. Both quantities are computed from structural/enumerated definitions in exact arithmetic with no Antecedent code. The front-door value uses the retained table of the front-door fixture as input (bound as an input fixture); its own derivation of that table is not re-reviewed here.
context_only_outputs: iv_effect, rd_jump, rd_hc1_variance, frontdoor_linear_effect and frontdoor_hc0_variance: no executing assertion reads these fixture fields (the design test hard-codes its own literals); not derived here
oracle.historical_exposure: Written during this review from the fixture README and the test's data construction; no product implementation source was consulted. Authorship of the original arithmetic is unrecorded.
